modmenu.descriptionTranslation.preventbu: A simple but flexible mod that prevents unwanted player actions described in the custom configs

maparthelper.config.title: PreventBuild Configuration
preventbuild.config.common.fixPickItemBy: Fix pick item by block desync fix
preventbuild.config.common.description.f: Fixes the issue when picking item by block (middle button click) can lead to a different player's held slot value between client and server, causing incorrect condition checks. This fix blocks any interactions while the client is waiting for a server's answer providing a new held slot value (note: normally, it takes fractions of a second)
preventbuild.config.common.maxWaitingTim: Maximum waiting time (ms) after picking item by block
preventbuild.config.common.description.m: Just-in-case setting to ensure the client won't get interactions blocked forever by a server-side or network problem. When the timeout is reached and the player interacts with anything, the mod stops waiting for an answer from the server
preventbuild.config.common.logWaitingTim: Log waiting time (sec) for a new held slot
preventbuild.config.common.description.l: Prints the time elapsed between picking item by block request and receiving a new held slot value in logs. Use it to make sure how long this fix blocks any interactions
